sources.name: Dynamix Wiki (Fandom, legacy)
sources.notes: Legacy English wiki (dynamixc4cat.fandom.com; dynamix.fandom.com is an unrelated game). Its CDN serves a transformed WEBP for /revision/latest unless format=original is requested; files are downloaded with format=original. The API size/SHA-1 of many files differ from the bytes format=original returns; that is recorded as source_reported versus download_observed, not as a second version. YouTube entries (video/youtube) are placeholders, not files. Last discovery: 4924 files (excluded 1448, pending 3476); enumeration complete. Metadata-only run: accepted files are pending download.
